title: StudySmarter says attackers copied user data from its learning app and support system
date_note: The page gives no earlier day than its publication on 27 November; the attack date is not stated.
geo_basis: Germany, as the article calls it a German learning platform; no city stated
summary: Caschys Blog reports that StudySmarter told users by email that attackers gained access to parts of its systems and copied data from the learning app and support system. The data includes email addresses, optional profile details and, for email-and-password accounts, salted password hashes. StudySmarter says it never stored plaintext passwords, payment data is not affected, and it logged all users out as a precaution.
plain: StudySmarter says attackers copied email addresses, optional profile details and salted password hashes. It says plaintext passwords and payment data are not affected and it logged all users out.
exec: StudySmarter says user data was copied in an attack and is still investigating the scope; the article gives no number of users.

validation.note: One publisher (Caschys Blog, read on a repost) relaying StudySmarter's email to users; the company's own page was not read.

review.note: Compared title, summary, hashes, payment, logout, single_source status against Caschys Blog article
